text:
elaine.p: Heads-up — Cloud marketplace team asked if we can introduce a 'reserved consumption floor' SKU for HW-bundled offers. Goal: reduce sticker shock for customers buying Dedicated + HW lease, and smooth renewal rates. Thoughts on pricing floor + renewal mechanics?

mike.sales: I like floor as a minimum commit (instead of % off). Keeps expected ARR tidy. Proposal: 12m min at 60% list for reserved consumption, then tiered overage credits.

anya.prod: If we do 60% at 12m, we should tie onboarding credits + SI delivery milestones so customers realize value before renewal. Otherwise churn risk.

elaine.p: @anya.prod agreed — want a concrete playbook for the first 90 days post-provisioning. SI enablement is key.

-suresh.si: From SI side — we can run a 90-day ramp: P0 deploy + P1 optimization + P2 knowledge transfer. Need an SKU to map services to credits. Example mapping: "HW-BUNDLE-PRIME": 4 days deployment credit, 8 days optimization credit.

mike.sales: We should also keep a renewal sweetener: 3% additional discount if they renew before month 9 and commit 10% uplift. That yields predictability without giving away margin at close.

liam.legal: Quick legal flags: (1) any conditioned discounts tied to deliverables need SOW clarity so we don't create implied obligations, (2) define non-refundable initial payment if we do a floor, and (3) articulate a clear downgrade path. I'll draft language.

anya.prod: Can we create two productized packages: "Starter Reserved" (lower floor, limited HW) and "Enterprise Reserved" (higher floor + SI premium + co-marketing). That makes renewal offers clearer.

elaine.p: Good. We'll draft pricing tiers. Also need comms plan for marketplace listing + joint press with HW partner. @suresh.si can you suggest timeline for SI-led announcement?

-suresh.si: Recommend soft launch to 3 pilot accounts in week 1, public marketplace listing week 4, partner joint webinar week 6. SI needs enablement docs by week 2.

deploy-bot: snapshot: Marketplace pilot interest form responses = 8 leads, preferred region = us-west-2, avg requested capacity = 2-4 GPUs. (See internal link: https://go.redwood/marketplace-pilot) :eyes:

mike.sales: For renewals, recommend automated milestone mailers: day 60 (usage report + success metrics), day 180 (renewal nudge + early-renew discount CTA), day 270 (last chance). Use account exec + SI success touchpoints.

anya.prod: Need telemetry hooks so we can show customer ROI in those emails. E.g., tokens saved from caching, latency SLOs achieved, cost per 1k tokens. Engineering can add counters.

elaine.p: Action items: @mike.sales draft tiered discount grid + renewal cadence; @anya.prod productize Starter/Enterprise reserved SKUs; @suresh.si create 90-day SI ramp template + enablement checklist; @liam.legal prepare contract language for non-refundable floor + deliverable-linked credits. I'll compile and sync Thurs 11am PT.

liam.legal: I'll have a draft term sheet by Wed EOD for review.

-suresh.si: I'll put the enablement checklist in the partnership folder and ping the SI slack channel.

mike.sales: I'll mock up pricing grid and sample customer-facing email copy.

elaine.p: Perfect — thanks all. Keeping this tight will help get HW partner co-marketing started. :thumbsup:

mike.sales: One more ask — can we include an escape hatch if HW delivery slips? Clause suggestion: pro-rata credit for delayed HW beyond 30 days. @liam.legal?

liam.legal: Yes, pro-rata credit is ok but specify mitigation steps and maximum cap. I'll add into the term sheet.

elaine.p: Great. Meeting Thurs to finalize.
